variants.title: 哑光纸景
variants.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Produce a high fidelity portrait concept board with TWO full desktop website screens stacked vertically, clean narrow gutter: top timeline landing, bottom project detail. Redesign the supplied portfolio, using reference images for CONTENT ONLY. Do NOT copy reference glossy metal frames, mirror highlights or physical glass. Brand exactly lowercase 'pixelcao'. Selected project in both screens 'PGOS', period '2021 — 至今', sentence '为游戏提供玩家匹配、组队与对战服务器托管。'. Timeline other stops: '近期' Brushline Rally and PhotoMuseum, '2025' Nex, '2019' 云游戏, '2018' Bot. Keep chronology descending; no invented achievements. Sparse interface: brand top left, '简历 ↗' top right, selected project title and short sentence and one '查看项目' button, necessary directional navigation. Detail: close X top right, full-resolution clear project images in a TWO-COLUMN MASONRY on the left, generous readable title and concise contributions on right ('规则驱动匹配', 'DS Hosting', 'Knative'); no big image plus thumbnail strip. PGOS media from reference includes a white matchmaking architecture diagram, colorful game-client streets and matching screen. Keep actual UI media recognizable, unpixelated and at native aspect ratios, distinct from website styling. No all works / selected works headings, no overview mode, no redundant secondary labels or ornament labels. Professional personal portfolio for job interviews, restrained and beautiful, generous negative space, clean Chinese sans-serif typography. No browser chrome or external annotations, no device mockups. Show consistent design grammar across both screens. DIRECTION 1: MATTE PAPER SPATIAL GALLERY. Light cream #F4F1E8, warm graphite #292C28, sparse muted vermilion #BD5544. Keep a diagonal exhibition path but reduce perspective dramatically: almost frontal prints with only small visible dark paper edges, no thick glass frames, no chrome or metal, no bevel shine, no glossy surfaces, no mirror floor, no glass blur, no reflections anywhere. Physical language is thick matte cut paper and architectural maquette, diffuse ambient illumination, short soft contact shadows, subtle tactile paper surface. Five prints displayed along a low plinth path with small square year markers. Selected PGOS slightly larger and lifted gently, unframed image on an ivory mat. Only wordmark, small numeral ticks, button silhouette and a few precise corners use pixel-grid details; Chinese titles remain contemporary, no dense pixel decoration. Cut paper layers feel tangible and calm. Homepage left text and right spatial arrangement. Detail is a warm paper page in front of gallery, thin flat ink edge with one restrained step corner, no reflective rim. This should feel editorial, crafted, quiet, spatial but visually coherent, not a computer game or futuristic showroom.

Sophisticated Swiss/editorial typography combined with sparse 4px square geometry: custom pixelcao wordmark, numerals as small bitmap font, square focus borders. Deep ink background #222C30, muted stone #B1BAA7, cream typography #F3ECD9, small warm amber #E0AD55. Pixel world has generous empty space, disciplined silhouette and limited detail, like a crafted microarchitecture illustration. Detail replaces the pixel world with a flat cream reading surface, small pixel corner brackets and charcoal text; actual colorful PGOS media remains high-resolution in masonry, not pixelated, with zero glass and zero bevel.
